newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Crown Equities sets stock rights offer.
newsitem.headline: Crown Equities sets stock rights offer.

text.p: Holding company Crown Equities Inc said on Tuesday it plans to raise 1.12 billion pesos through a stock rights offer of seven shares for every ten shares held.
The issue size is 700 million shares at an offer price of 1.60 pesos per share.
The record date of the rights offer will be 15 days after the approval of the Philippine Stock Exchange, the company said.
It also announced that its management will pursue discussions and sign pacts with strategic parties for the manufacture and sale of industrial and construction products.
Crown Equities was formerly Southeast Pacific Rim Resources & Development Corp.
